title: 第一三五七章 我们回家吧 大结局第一三五六章 狄九的一寸光阴
content_zh:
虚暮伦绝望的闭上了眼睛，他知道哪怕他修为通天，今天也是必死无疑。此刻他有些后悔，不应该招惹狄九的。
狄九连这种可以晋级的新规则宇宙都可以构建起来，能简单到哪里去?如果一个全新的规则宇宙如此简单话，那虚暮伦他何必来这里剥离别人的宇宙道则和筋骨？他自己就可以构建这种全新大道道则的宇宙啊。
他被掌控浩瀚迷失了双眼，竟然和姜千王一起，想着要灭掉这个顶级的规则宇宙。
现在，他果然是有了报应。他和姜千王渴望这新宇宙的一切顶级规则，现在他即将陨落，姜千王却是早已神魂俱灭了。
行百里者果然是半九十九，他虚暮伦即将跨入巅峰，只差那么一点点。若是他能在小心一些，绝不至于如今天这样。
虚暮伦再张开眼睛看了一眼狄九，他没有求饶。就算是狄九会饶他，他也不会求饶。他虚暮伦有他虚暮伦的骄傲，如果不能掌控浩瀚，绝对不会去做别人的一条狗，哪怕这个人是用三箭就能够射杀他的狄九。
他只希望狄九想要打开他的宇宙世界，不会射出这第三箭。只要狄九的一寸光阴有些许间隙，他就有机会遁入混沌，逃得一命。不但他能逃走，还能带走一支一寸光阴炼制的长箭。
他的希望很大，因为在狄九眼里，此刻他虚暮伦应该是任人宰杀了。就算是一个蝼蚁过来，也许都能杀掉他虚暮伦。换成是他的话，他一样会停止射第三箭，打开对方的宇宙世界。他虚暮伦修道至今，宇宙世界之中不知道有多少让所有人眼红的宝物。
将来若是有一天他再回来的时候，这一寸光阴长箭，就是狄九的催命符。
“咔嚓！”岁月长弓断裂，第三支一寸光阴长箭也脱弦而出。狄九没有犯下和虚暮伦一样的错误，哪怕岁月长弓断裂，他也没有打算收起第三箭。
弓出光阴止，一箭锁轮回！
这一箭之下，一切都静止下来，虚暮伦甚至无法看清楚自己的轮回，他的轮回同样被这一箭锁住，消失的无影无踪。这瞬息时间，虚暮伦明白了，他永远也不会成为狄九，狄九不会因为贪婪而犯下致命的错误。
嘭！虚暮伦的整个身体都在这一箭之下炸裂，人也是化为了虚无，消失在浩瀚混沌之中，再也没有半点踪迹。
狄九脸色同样的苍白无比，他从头到尾都没有想过打开虚暮伦的宇宙世界。他肯定，只要自己的岁月长箭有一丝生机缝隙，虚暮伦就会消失的无影无踪。虚暮伦如果连这点本事也没有的话，绝不敢承受自己的第一箭。
放九重下意识的咽了一口口水，然后才反应过来，惊喜激动的叫道，“狄兄，真没有想到你竟然干掉了虚暮伦。”
放九重的确是没有想到狄九可以干掉虚暮伦，在放九重心里，狄九杀掉虚暮伦的这一刻，就意味着浩瀚混沌之中已经没有人再能超越他了。也许他自己都没有意识到，他说话的语气已有了一些变化。
狄九缓了一口气，他的神念直接穿过了混沌和新宇宙的界域，当他看见新规则宇宙的那一刻，眼眶有些忍不住模糊起来。
他的神念扫到了农秀琪，和农秀琪在一起的竟然是狄笛。狄笛终于回来了，还比他更早回来。
然后狄九看见了狄今昔和北浣浣。在狄今昔旁边坐着的，那应该是狄忘川和狄秋水吧。应该就是了，因为心女就在这两人身后站着。在看见心女的时候，狄九再也忍不住，抬手揉了一下自己的眼睛。
然后他看见了耿戟，看见了树弟和黑火，还有无数他熟悉的朋友、亲人……

从今天开始，再也没有任何人能胁迫他狄九离开这一方宇宙世界，从今天开始，他将和亲人们在一起，不用再分离。
“狄兄……”放九重感受到了狄九难以平息的心情，忍不住叫了一句。
“太爷……”闪电冲了过来，落在了狄九身边。
狄九在虚空之中捡起一片金叶，他的目光再次看向了新宇宙世界，语气柔和的说道，“我们回家吧。”
“狄兄，不知道可否介意我去你家坐坐。”放九重一抱拳，语气中同样带着一种激动和渴望。
在浩瀚之中，能结交到狄九这种朋友，那不是运气，而是一种机缘。
狄九哈哈一笑，“欢迎之极。”
说完，狄九抬手撕开混沌，当他的手触摸到新宇宙界域的时候，脸色一变。
“怎么？”放九重看见狄九的脸色，心里也是一跳。
狄九没有回答放九重的话，忽然虚空抓出一道规则，在狄九的道韵之下，这一道规则瞬息化为了一方虚空影像，影像模糊不清。可狄九依然清晰的看清楚了影像中的人。
那正是叶默和宁城。
影像极为模糊，很快就消失不见。可是狄九却清晰的感受到了一种不安和压抑，狄九确信自己没有感应错。这一方新宇宙是他和叶默、宁城一起构建的，站在这里，他同样感受到宁城和叶默的不安。他甚至可以感受到叶默和宁城如今的实力不会比他低，可那种不安和压抑依然清晰存在。
这道则影像绝对是叶默或者是宁城通过新宇宙大道感应留下来的，他们留下这影像是告诉自己，他们去了哪里。这道则影像，也只有自己可以感应到。
一道模糊的道则讯息传来，“狄九兄弟，我和叶默可能回不来了，新宇宙我们一直没有起名字，你如果回来了，记得给我们的新宇宙起个名字……”
“放道友，我必须要去帮一下我的兄弟，我的两个兄弟现在需要我，你和闪电他们留在新宇宙等我。闪电，你和丁小叮你们在新宇宙等我，告诉我的家人，我很快就回来。对了，以后这个新宇宙就叫着第九宇宙。”
狄九说完后，将丁小叮和闪电送下。他已经卷起混沌飞星消失在混沌之中，他甚至没有来得及回家，他甚至没有来得及和放九重告辞。
因为如果不是叶默和宁城，当年他一样陨落了。如今他们三个构建起来了第九宇宙，叶默和宁城的事情，就是他狄九的事情。他之所以没有叫放九重一起过去，是很清楚，放九重的实力过去也帮不上忙。
“叶兄……”放九重呆滞的看着狄九消失的方向，一时间不知道应该追上去帮忙，还是在这里等狄九。
随着狄九离开，刚才狄九和虚暮伦战斗的混沌虚空，破碎不堪的规则迅速消失不见。混沌再次虚化了万物的存在，将所有的痕迹都抹去。浩瀚寂静下来，就好像一切从未发生过一般，无尽混沌显得安静而恬淡。（大结局）
……

《天下第九》写到这里就全部结束了，狄九去混沌寻找叶默和宁城的故事我不打算在这里续下去了。事实上，在一两个月前，我就应该结束这本书的，结果还是勉强写到了今天。
狄九寻找叶默和宁城的故事和本书无关了，有部分道友喜欢的话，我就尝试着写几章外传吧，放在微信公众号里面。接下来我有一段休息时间，新书写都市星空修真的机会非常非常低。
过两天写一个后记，说一下这本书吧。
我的微信公众号是eslw26，或者直接搜‘鹅是老五’。公众号很久也没有更新了，这本书完本后，后面我会更新关于新书的一些枝叶。
（朋友们晚安！）
content_en:
Xu Mulun closed his eyes in despair. He knew that even if he cultivated to the sky, he would definitely die today. At this moment, he felt a little regretful, he shouldn't have provoked Di Jiu.
Di Jiulian can build a new rules universe that can be promoted, how simple can it be? If a brand new rules universe is so simple, then why does Xu Mulun come here to peel off other people's universe rules and bones? He himself can build this new universe of great principles.
He was blinded by the vastness of control, and he and Jiang Qianwang were thinking of destroying this top rules universe.
Now, he really got his comeuppance. He and Jiang Qianwang long for all the top rules of this new universe. Now that he is about to die, Jiang Qianwang has already lost his soul.
As expected, those who can walk a hundred miles are half-ninety-nine. He, Xu Mu Lun, is about to reach his peak, just a little short of it. If he had been more careful, he would never be like this.
Xu Mulun opened his eyes and glanced at Di Jiu again. He did not beg for mercy. Even if Di Jiu would forgive him, he would not beg for mercy. He, Xu Mulun, has his own pride. If he can't control the vastness, he will never be someone else's dog, even if this person can kill his Di Jiu with three arrows.
He only hoped that Di Jiu would not shoot this third arrow if he wanted to open up his universe. As long as there is a slight gap in Di Jiu's time, he will have a chance to escape into chaos and escape with his life. Not only could he escape, but he could also take away a long arrow that took one inch of time to refine.
He had great hopes, because in Di Jiu's eyes, he, Xu Mulun, should be left to be slaughtered at this moment. Even if an ant comes over, it may be able to kill Xu Mulun. If it were him, he would still stop shooting the third arrow and open up the opponent's universe. Since he has been practicing Taoism in Xu Mulun, there are countless treasures in the universe that make everyone jealous.
If he comes back one day in the future, this moment will be Di Jiu's life-saving talisman.
"Crack!" The long bow of time broke, and the third one-inch long arrow of time came out of the string. Di Jiu did not make the same mistake as Xu Mulun. Even if the bow of time broke, he had no intention of putting away the third arrow.
When the bow comes out, time stops, and one arrow locks reincarnation!
Under this arrow, everything stopped. Xu Mulun could not even see his own reincarnation clearly. His reincarnation was also locked by this arrow and disappeared without a trace. In this blink of an eye, Xu Mulun understood that he would never become Di Jiu, and Di Jiu would not make fatal mistakes because of greed.
Bang! Xu Mulun's entire body exploded under this arrow, and the man turned into nothingness, disappearing into the vast chaos, without any trace left.
Di Jiu's face was also extremely pale. He never thought about opening the universe of Xu Mulun from the beginning to the end. He was sure that as long as there was a slight crack of vitality in his long arrow of time, Xu Mulun would disappear without a trace. If Xu Mulun didn't even have this ability, he would never dare to bear his first arrow.
Fang Jiuzhong swallowed subconsciously, and then realized what he was doing. He shouted in surprise and excitement, "Brother Di, I really didn't expect you to kill Xu Mulun."
Fang Jiuzhong did not expect that Di Jiu could kill Xu Mulun. In Fang Jiuzhong's heart, the moment Di Jiu killed Xu Mulun meant that no one in the vast chaos could surpass him. Perhaps he didn't even realize that the tone of his voice had changed.
Di Jiu breathed a sigh of relief. His spiritual thoughts passed directly through the realm of chaos and the new universe. When he saw the new rules universe, his eyes couldn't help but blur.
His spiritual mind scanned Nong Xiuqi, and the person with Nong Xiuqi turned out to be Di Di. Didi finally came back, even earlier than him.
Then Di Jiu saw Di Jinxi and Bei Huanhuan. Sitting next to Di Jinxi should be Di Wangchuan and Di Qiushui. That should be it, because my heart girlStanding behind these two people. When he saw his beloved daughter, Di Jiu couldn't help it anymore and raised his hand to rub his eyes.
Then he saw Geng Ji, Shudi and Black Fire, as well as countless friends and relatives he was familiar with...
From today on, no one can force Di Jiu to leave this universe. From today on, he will be with his relatives and no longer need to be separated.
"Brother Di..." Fang Jiuzhong felt Di Jiu's uneasy mood and couldn't help but shout.
"Master..." Lightning rushed over and landed next to Di Jiu.
Di Jiu picked up a golden leaf in the void, looked at the new universe again, and said softly, "Let's go home."
"Brother Di, I wonder if you would mind if I came to your house to sit down." Fang Jiuzhong clasped his fists, his tone also filled with excitement and desire.
In the vastness, being able to make friends like Di Jiu is not luck, but a chance.
Di Jiu laughed, "It's very welcome."
After saying that, Di Jiu raised his hand to tear apart the chaos. When his hand touched the new universe realm, his expression changed.
"What?" Fang Jiuzhong's heart skipped a beat when he saw Di Jiu's expression.
Di Jiu did not answer Fang Jiuzhong's words, and suddenly a rule was drawn out of the void. Under Di Jiu's Taoist rhyme, this rule instantly turned into an image in the void, and the image was blurred. But Di Jiu could still clearly see the person in the image.
Those were Ye Mo and Ning Cheng.
The image was extremely blurry and quickly disappeared. But Di Jiu clearly felt a kind of uneasiness and depression. Di Jiu was sure that he was not wrong. This new universe was built by him, Ye Mo, and Ning Cheng. Standing here, he also felt the uneasiness of Ning Cheng and Ye Mo. He could even feel that Ye Mo and Ning Cheng were no less powerful than him now, but the uneasiness and depression were still clearly there.
This image was definitely left by Ye Mo or Ning Cheng through the induction of the New Universe Avenue. They left this image to tell themselves where they went. This Tao image can only be sensed by oneself.
A vague Taoist message came, "Brother Di Jiu, Ye Mo and I may not be able to come back. We haven't named the new universe yet. If you come back, remember to give our new universe a name..."
"Fellow Taoist, I have to go and help my brothers. My two brothers need me now. You and Lightning are waiting for me in the new universe. Lightning, you and Ding Xiaoding are waiting for me in the new universe. Tell my family that I will be back soon. By the way, this new universe will be called the Ninth Universe from now on."
After Di Jiu finished speaking, he sent Ding Xiaoding and Lightning down. He had rolled up the Chaos Flying Star and disappeared into the chaos. He didn't even have time to go home, and he didn't even have time to say goodbye to Fang Jiuzhong.
Because if it weren't for Ye Mo and Ning Cheng, he would have fallen as well. Now that the three of them have built the ninth universe, Ye Mo and Ning Cheng's affairs are his and Di Jiu's affairs. The reason why he didn't ask Fang Jiuzhong to come with him was because he knew very well that Fang Jiuzhong's strength couldn't help him in the past.
"Brother Ye..." Fang Jiuzhong looked blankly at the direction in which Di Jiu disappeared. For a moment, he didn't know whether he should catch up to help or wait for Di Jiu here.
As Di Jiu left, the chaotic void where Di Jiu and Xu Mulun fought just now, and the broken rules quickly disappeared. Chaos once again blurred the existence of all things, erasing all traces. The vastness fell silent, as if nothing had ever happened, and the endless chaos seemed quiet and tranquil. (finale)
…
"The Ninth World" ends here. I don't plan to continue the story of Di Jiu going to Chaos to find Ye Mo and Ning Cheng. In fact, I should have finished this book a month or two ago, but I still managed to finish it today.
The story of Di Jiu looking for Ye Mo and Ning ChengIt has nothing to do with this book. If some Taoist friends like it, I will try to write a few chapters and put them in the WeChat official account. Next I have a break, and the chance of writing a new book on Urban Starry Sky Cultivation is very, very low.
I will write a postscript in two days and talk about this book.
My WeChat official account is eslw26, or you can directly search for ‘Goose is Lao Wu’. The official account has not been updated for a long time. After this book is completed, I will update some details about the new book later.
(Good night friends!)
